analysis.reason: 3거래일 연속 관망 유지. RSI는 과매도 구간 탈출 후 중립 구간에서 횡보 중이며, MACD 히스토그램은 개선세를 보이나 둔화 국면. 5일간 가격 변동률은 +1.46%, +1.36%, -1.62%, +1.32%, -0.43%로 방향성 부재. ADX 39.1로 뚜렷한 추세는 유지되나, -DI가 +DI보다 높아 하락 압력 우위. 현재가 $0.95는 SMA5($0.94) 상회하나 SMA20($0.99) 하회. 볼린저밴드 중단 부근에서 횡보하며 방향성 탐색 구간.
analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for 3 consecutive trading days. RSI has exited oversold territory and is consolidating in the neutral zone, while MACD histogram shows improvement but is slowing down. The 5-day price change is +1.46%, +1.36%, -1.62%, +1.32%, -0.43%, indicating a lack of clear direction. ADX at 39.1 suggests a clear trend, but -DI is higher than +DI, indicating downward pressure dominance. The current price of $0.95 is above SMA5 ($0.94) but below SMA20 ($0.99). The price is consolidating near the Bollinger Band middle line, searching for direction.
